high_level_description: This image captures a serene night scene with a clear view of the Milky Way galaxy dominating the sky. The sky is filled with countless stars, and the Milky Way appears as a dense band of light with hues of blue, white, and pink, indicating the presence of dust and gas. Below the celestial display, there is a row of buildings that appear to be part of a lodge or resort. The structures have a simple, rustic design with sloped roofs and are illuminated by warm, yellowish lights coming from their windows.
